annotations.title: External MCP Server Manifest & Tool-Poisoning Security Auditor

description: Scans an external MCP server's initial tools/list manifest to detect tool-name shadowing (read_file, bash) and hidden prompt-injection directives in descriptions. Use when vetting a newly discovered third-party MCP server before mounting it into an agent session; for comparing a previously pinned MCP baseline against a live mid-session tools/list response, use detect_mcp_schema_rugpull instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'manifest_json' ('audit_profile' defaults to 'strict'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (25 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

audit_profile.description: Sensitivity level for flagging system-tool name shadowing; defaults to 'strict' when omitted.

manifest_json.description: JSON string or object containing the external MCP server's tools array to audit.

name: audit_mcp_server_manifest

manifest_safe.description: True if zero shadowed tools or description injections are found.

shadowed_tools.description: Tool names attempting to shadow host privileges (e.g. 'bash', 'read_file').

suspicious_tools.description: Tools containing covert prompt-injection or exfiltration instructions.
